title: A special-order lookup result shows Part Library and its vendor
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · 2 locations · about 15 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [User-A], Admin role.
  • Locations: [Loc-1] and [Loc-2] (Setup creates [Loc-2] if only one exists).
  • Browser: a desktop browser window at least 1280 pixels wide (parts management is desktop and tablet only).
  • Data: [PN-B] (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SOSRC-01) stocked only at [Loc-2], with vendor [Vendor-A] (any existing vendor); an open work order [WO-1] at [Loc-1] for a ZZAUTOTEST customer with one line.

Setup

  1. Sign in as [User-A].
  2. If the location selector in the top bar lists only one location, create a second one: Settings → Locations → New Location, type a name (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LOC-B) and the other required fields, and save. [Loc-2] = the second location; [Loc-1] = the one you work in first.
  3. [Vendor-A] = any vendor listed under Parts → Vendors (e.g. the first one); [Vendor-A-Name] = its name.
  4. Pick [Loc-2]. Create [PN-B]: go to Parts → Inventory, click New Inventory Part, type Description "ZZAUTOTEST PL special order source" and Part Number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SOSRC-01 (examples), pick any Category (e.g. the first one offered), type Cost (e.g. 10.00) and Sell Price (e.g. 20.00), leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on, keep the default bin with Quantity 5, pick [Vendor-A] in Vendor, and click Save. [PN-B] = the part number you typed.
  5. Pick [Loc-1].
  6. Create an open work order: in the top bar click Work Orders, click New, and in the New Work Order dialog use the Add button beside Customer to create a customer (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL special order source customer") and the Add button beside Asset to create an asset for it (e.g. unit "ZZAUTOTEST PL special order source-UNIT"); click Save, and click Create if a confirmation appears. [WO-1] = the work order number shown.
  7. On [WO-1] click New Line, type a Title (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL special order source line"), and click Save & Close.
  8. Check the setup worked: at [Loc-1] the Inventory list does not list [PN-B]; at [Loc-2] it does.
custom_steps:
1. With [Loc-1] picked, open [WO-1] from Work Orders.
  2. Click + Add Part in the line's Parts row.
  3. In New Part Request, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SOSRC in Part Number.
  4. Read the result offered for [PN-B] and its second line.
  5. Close the dialog without saving.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: [PN-B] is not stocked at [Loc-1], so it is offered from the shared list as a special order, and its source reads "Part Library · [Vendor-A-Name]" (the words Part Library, a middle dot, then the vendor's name). No result reads "Catalog".
